full_assessment.summary: This product contains high-risk preservatives (Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons (PAHs)). Regular consumption may increase health risks.

high_risk.name: Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons (PAHs)
high_risk.micro_report: **  [PAHs form during the smoking process at high temperatures.  They are potent carcinogens, linked to various cancers through DNA damage and oxidative stress.  The type and amount of PAHs depend on the smoking method and wood type.  (Source: IARC Monographs on the Evaluation of Carcinogenic Risks to Humans)]. [1][2]

moderate_risk.name: Sodium (if added)
moderate_risk.micro_report: ** [Sodium chloride (salt) is often added to enhance flavor. Excessive sodium intake is linked to hypertension and cardiovascular disease.  Moderation is key; recommended daily intake is generally under 2300mg. (Source: American Heart Association)]. [3][4]

moderate_risk.name: Nitrites/Nitrates (if added)
moderate_risk.micro_report: ** [These preservatives are sometimes used in processed meats.  While they prevent botulism, they can form nitrosamines during cooking, which are carcinogenic.  The risk depends on the amount and cooking method. (Source: National Cancer Institute)]. [5][6]

low_risk.name: Hickory Wood Smoke (Caryer)
low_risk.micro_report: ** [Generally safe, but PAH formation is a concern as mentioned above.]

low_risk.name: *Important Note
low_risk.micro_report: ** This analysis is based on the potential presence of ingredients commonly found in processed smoked chicken.  A complete risk assessment requires a full ingredient list and information on processing methods (temperature, duration, type of smoke, etc.).  The absence of specific ingredients does not guarantee the absence of risk.
